body: SCOUT READ-ONLY REVIEW of 59f8fd0: BLOCK pending one load-bearing test and contract tightening. SignatureSuite never calls RecallSignature.externalMass; every test constructs ExternalMassReport directly. Mutate the production accessor to attributed = five terms + unranked, omit a term, swap fields, or return constants and all five tests remain green. Add one real RecallSignature with distinct six masses and assert the accessor exact split; then perform the re-add-unranked mutation and show red. Second: public case class construction admits negative, >1 and NaN values, yielding rankedMass outside [0,1], against smart-constructor discipline; make it a validated/private view or state why direct construction is acceptable. Third, narrow the structural claim: sig.externalMass.attributed is still a bare Double that can travel without rankedMass, and the macro bans only accessors literally named total/externalMass, not any accessor returning a sum. The change does prevent the old accidental conflated accessor, does not renormalize, and the split itself is scientifically right; the evidence currently proves the helper shape, not the production fix.
